change.summary: Attach a WebSocket watcher before the seed helper navigates, arm a task-scoped session.launch response wait before submit, and await that response before asserting the dialog closed.

ci.assertion: The New agent/Hand off dialog was still visible at the post-submit close assertion.

observed_state: Dialog title: New agent in New Agent settings.
Prompt remains /e2e:simple-message and is disabled while submitting.
session-note.txt and Remove session-note.txt remain present.
Advanced settings is expanded; MCP servers shows 1 selected.
Cancel and Creating... are disabled; no visible validation error is recorded.

failed_screenshot.observation: The screenshot attached to the failed result shows the task chat with the submitted prompt and attachment; it appears later than the accessibility snapshot, which still shows Creating... .

diagnosis.source_contract: useSessionLaunchSubmit sets creating before launchSession; it activates the returned session and calls onClose only after the session.launch WebSocket request resolves. The spec's expectCreatedSelection helper polls persisted session, MCP selection, and user-message state, which can become observable before that RPC reply reaches the UI.
diagnosis.uncertainty: The failed result contains screenshot and error-context attachments but no failed trace or recorded WS request/reply event. The evidence supports a pending-launch-response race rather than rejected form validation, but does not prove exact event ordering. The retry-1 trace is passing and was not used as a failed trace.
